filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window ≈ Oct 8–9 PT

market_briefing.lede: GTM agents are being handed outcomes instead of steps, and the vendors shipping them are adding loops to learn and limits to stay in check. On Oct 8 Clay previewed an agent that runs plays and proposes ICP changes from results, Microsoft packaged Dynamics 365 as Copilot skills that stop at proposals, and Google gave its Gemini agent its own Workspace identity and audit trail.

bullets.text: CRM as skills: Microsoft (Oct 8) made 30 Dynamics 365 CRM skills for Copilot Cowork generally available, built on MCP tools across Sales, Customer Service and Customer Insights. Autopilot for recurring work is in private preview, and skills separate analysis, proposed changes and completed actions.

Agent as coworker: Google's Gemini agent (Oct 8) gets its own Workspace account and email, writes an audit trail attributed to the agent, connects to Slack, Microsoft 365, Snowflake and any MCP server, and lets users pick Claude. Real-time spend caps are part of the launch.

Outcome budgets: Hone (Oct 8) raised a seed co-led by Benchmark and Index for 'engines' that own outcomes, starting with account management. It is exploring budget-based pricing instead of per-seat or per-task. Round size not disclosed.

biggest_ai_news.title: Google launches the Gemini agent for work
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 8: one agent that takes objectives, delegates to subagents, connects to business systems and any MCP server, and offers Claude in the model picker. Business first; consumers later.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic launches OSS Scanner and a critical-infrastructure defense program
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 8: free, opt-in model-generated vulnerability scans for eligible open-source projects (reports unreviewed by humans), plus a program with 11 founding partners including CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks and Deloitte.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI expands GPT-6 Intelligent UI to Free and Go users
biggest_ai_news.body: Rollout began Oct 7 on paid plans and reached Free and Go from Oct 8: interactive charts, forms and calculators inside ChatGPT answers. Applies to Chat, not Work or Codex.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI fires three safety researchers, citing a breach of trust
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 9: OpenAI says the three violated policies on handling sensitive information; the researchers say they were removed for prioritizing safety.

what_changed.title: Clay launches an agent-first way to build, Workflows and an Inbound SDR Agent at Sculpt
what_changed.body: NEW (watchlist). Oct 8: an agent plans, runs and improves outcome-based plays using Knowledge Hub (ICP, personas, positioning), suggests ICP updates from results, and schedules its own check-ins. Beta for Sculpt attendees, early-access users in coming weeks. Workflows (visual canvas; branch, loop, code, agent steps; built from chat or CLI) is in beta for all Clay users, full launch this fall. Inbound SDR Agent (voice qualification, sandbox demo, routes to rep calendars, trained on past demo calls) is preview/waitlist only. No pricing announced. Why it matters: Clay now has a seller agent of its own, not just data and orchestration under someone else's.

what_changed.title: Microsoft ships 30 Dynamics 365 CRM skills for Copilot
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 8: skills GA in Copilot Cowork over 180+ GA tools; Autopilot private preview; Code via Frontier. Examples: pipeline prioritizer, deal rescue, 30-day account plan, case triage. Skills respect Dynamics 365 and Microsoft 365 permissions and keep proposed changes distinct from saved ones.

what_changed.title: Google's Gemini agent works as a named coworker with its own audit trail
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 8 at Gemini at Work: objectives, skills, subagents, a tasks inbox, connectors (Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Jira, Snowflake, Databricks, any MCP server), Claude in the model picker, and spend caps. Early testers include Shopify and PayPal.

what_changed.title: Hone raises a seed for AI 'engines' that own account-management outcomes
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 8: co-led by Benchmark and Index; founder previously at Cognition. Template engines for GTM, recruiting, financial risk and procurement; exploring budget-based pricing. Round size not disclosed.

what_changed.title: Outreach publishes a commissioned Forrester TEI study
what_changed.body: Low signal (watchlist). Oct 8: 244% three-year ROI and payback under six months for a composite organization. The study says most modeled value comes from workflow standardization and automation; the composite is still in early pilots with Amplify, Outreach's agentic offering.

quiet_note: No net-new product PR Oct 8–9 from Gong, Nooks, Salesloft or Monaco. Salesforce's Oct 8 X posts restated Hunter (pilot; GA planned November) and Claudeforce (announced Aug 27), filed to its competitor page. Aged off Today: Sierra/Meta Personal Agent Protocol, Claude for Google Workspace, HG Insights platform, OpenAI math manuscripts (Oct 6); Salesforce zero-trust post, Surface Laptop Ultra, SynthID Detector (Oct 7). X API pull failed again (402); public X search used as fallback.

watch.title: Salesforce's October GAs: Agent Optimizer and AI Skills
watch.body: Salesforce's Sep 11 announcement put both at GA in October '26: Agent Optimizer (an agent that builds, tests and tunes other agents) and AI Skills in Agentforce Coworker (teach a task once, scale it). Hunter, the outbound sales agent, stays in pilot until November. Watch for GA confirmation and pricing, now that Clay and Microsoft have shipped comparable skill and agent layers.

interpretation.fact: Clay launched an agent-first build mode (beta), Workflows (beta for all) and previewed an Inbound SDR Agent at Sculpt (Oct 8). Microsoft made 30 Dynamics 365 CRM skills GA (Oct 8). Google launched the Gemini agent (Oct 8). Anthropic launched OSS Scanner and a critical-infrastructure program (Oct 8). OpenAI expanded GPT-6 Intelligent UI (Oct 8) and fired three safety researchers (Oct 9). Hone raised a seed (Oct 8). Outreach released a commissioned TEI study (Oct 8).
interpretation.note: Light interpretation: the agent layer for GTM is converging on the same pattern from three directions (data/orchestration, CRM, workplace suite): outcome-level tasks, MCP/skills access to CRM, and human approval before writes. Clay's Inbound SDR Agent is preview-only, so its competitive effect on AI SDR vendors is not yet measurable.
